name: express
description: Express this Individual's genotype into a Grating phenotype

form_config.name: individuals
form_config.label: Individual(s)
form_config.description: The individuals to express. Each genome is written out as its own grating, the individual's phenotype as a standalone file, placed inside the individual. Switched-off layers stay off and their stored weights are not kept. Generating doesn't need this; express to reuse or share an individual as a grating.
